$VULT —POWERING SEXURE, MULTI-CHAIN SELF-CUSTODY.

Vultisig is redefining how users secure and manage their crypto assets through a next-generation self-custody wallet built on Multi-Party Computation (MPC) technology. Unlike traditional wallets that rely on vulnerable seed phrases, Vultisig eliminates single points of failure by splitting key control across multiple parties — significantly improving security.
